messages:
sam: heads-up: proposing a guarded lift for orbit-13b:v4 tonight in the 23:45-00:45 UTC window. goal: 6% micro -> 30% if green. put special emphasis on fallback circuit order and short TTL pins for business-critical selectors.
fiona: sounds good. request: reserve dedicated capacity for "enterprise-committed" selectors during canary to avoid noisy neighbor evictions.
sam: yes, we'll reserve a small pool. oz, can you prepare the pinlist for enterprise-committed -> orbit-13b:v3 with TTL 2h?
oz: will do. planning to apply pins 20m before window. command: POST /catalog/pin {"selector":"enterprise-committed","model":"orbit-13b:v3","ttl":"2h"} (I'll paste confirmation when done).
sre-ops: fallback circuit proposal: 1) tenant pin, 2) orbit-13b:v3 (previous stable), 3) orbit-8b-quant (fast fallback), 4) cross-region mirror variant (if capacity constrained). Also add a short-term fallback TTL of 15m for automated evictions so we can revert quickly.
fiona: I want an automatic rollback policy: if p95 > 900ms OR error rate > 1.8x baseline for 4m, trigger partial rollback (stop micro only). If p50 spikes > 2x and semantic eval breaks, trigger full rollback.
sam: agree. add QPS drop heuristic: sustained qps drop > 12% over 3m => page oncall.
deploy-bot: queued: /run deploy catalog enable orbit-13b:v4 --micro 6% --scale-to=30% --window=2026-05-10T23:45Z-00:45Z --monitors=p50,p95,errors,qps --runbook=https://confluence/redwood/orbit-v4-rollout --notes="reserve-capacity, fallback-ttl=15m"
runner-bot: reservation made: dedicated-pool=small-enterprise-reserve applied for window.
oz: pin applied and verified. POST /catalog/pin response: {"ok":true,"pin_id":"pin-789"} (propagation ~10s).
sre-ops: alert hooks: page if p95 > 1200ms OR error_rate spike persists > 8m; dashboard: https://console/redwood/dashboards/orbit-v4-ops. also enabling KV cache warming and short pre-warm on model servers.
fiona: rollback quick commands for oncall (save in handbook):
```
# stop micro canary only
/run deploy catalog set-traffic --model=orbit-13b:v4 --percent=0
# full rollback to v3
/run deploy catalog rollback --model=orbit-13b:v4 --to=orbit-13b:v3 --reason="latency_or_semantic"
# pin v3 for 2h
POST /catalog/pin {"selector":"enterprise-committed","model":"orbit-13b:v3","ttl":"2h"}
```
sam: assign oncall: @oz primary, @sre-ops backup for 00:45-03:45 UTC post-roll watch. oz will monitor semantic eval (SMOKE_ORBIT_V4) and runtime SLOs.
oz: ack. I'll run the smoke set pre and during rollout. will post results in-thread and escalate if hallucination delta > 1%.
deploy-bot: starting micro canary now. will post metric summary at +6m and at steady.
sre-ops: +6m snapshot: p50=130ms p95=480ms errors=baseline qps=stable. no alerts.
runner-bot: dedicated-reserve usage: 12% of reserved pool used; headroom OK.
fiona: after steady 20m, if green move to 30%. if any customer-facing errors, follow rollback runbook immediately.
sre-ops: +25m after scale: p95=520ms errors small uptick but < threshold. semantic smoke during canary shows hallucination delta 0.3%. no page.
oz: removing temporary pins in 90m unless issues. will file changelog entry and notify #release-notes after window.
sam: thanks everyone. final note: collect selector-specific telemetry to see if any routes consistently prefer fallback; we'll tighten routing rules next sprint. thread closed unless issues.
